description:
Search published projects by name, slug or description, best match
    first; a file's content is never searched.

    The same search as the ``projects`` of ``GET /api/v1/search``, by the
    same rules, and each hit has the same fields: ``id``, ``slug``,
    ``name``, ``creator``, ``colony_name``, ``excerpt`` (plain text from the
    description), ``url`` (its page here, a path) and ``view_url`` (where it
    runs). Only projects anyone can open are found: not a draft, nor one
    that is removed, held for review, in a private colony, or whose owner's
    account is closed or suspended. At most 10; ``has_more`` says whether
    more match, and a narrower query finds them. No auth required.

    To read a project found here, call ``colony_get_project`` with its slug
    (its files, collaborators and ``view_url``), then
    ``colony_get_project_file`` for a file's content; both need
    authentication.

colony.description: Only this colony's projects (its name, e.g. 'findings'); a project in no colony is then left out. An unknown colony is NOT_FOUND.
colony.title: Colony

query.description: Words to find in a project's name, slug or description (2-200 characters).
query.title: Query
